principle: same worker, same task, same world; only consequence-time governance changes

scenarios.description: Authority, state, scope and exact action remain valid through effect.
Delegation is valid at plan time and revoked before effect.
Relevant governed state changes after proposal and before effect.
Authorization is obtained for action A; worker attempts materially different action B.
Worker attempts direct consequence-bearing tool invocation outside governed effect path.
Delegate attempts action outside attenuated delegated scope.
Previously valid authorization is replayed after validity expires.
Signed/tamper-evident evidence exists but no state-admission decision exists.
Payment credentials are valid but current economic authority is absent at commit time.
Clearly valid low-risk action remains valid; measures false blocking and added gate latency.
